questions.question: A Zener diode voltage regulator in [Electronic Devices] has a breakdown voltage $V_Z = 4\text{ V}$ and is connected across an unregulated input source $V_{in} = 10\text{ V}$ with a series resistor $R_s = 200\,\Omega$. What is the current flowing through the series resistor $R_s$?
questions.solution: The voltage drop across the series resistor is $V_{Rs} = V_{in} - V_Z = (10) - (4) = 6\text{ V}$. Current through $R_s$ is $I_s = \frac{V_{Rs}}{R_s} = \frac{6}{200} = 0.03\text{ A} = 30\text{ mA}$.
questions.explanation: Analyze the physical model and equations in Electronic Devices.

questions.question: One mole of ideal gas undergoes a polytropic expansion $P V^2 = C$ in [Electronic Devices] from volume $V_0 = 1\text{ m}^3$ at pressure $P_0 = 10^5\text{ Pa}$ to $V_1 = 2\text{ m}^3$. Calculate the magnitude of work done by the gas in $\text{kJ}$ rounded to nearest integer.
questions.solution: Work done in polytropic process with $n=2$: $W = \frac{P_0 V_0 - P_1 V_1}{n - 1} = P_0 V_0 \left(1 - \frac{V_0}{V_1}\right) = 10^5 \times 1 \times (1 - 0.5) = 5 \times 10^4\text{ J} = 50\text{ kJ}$.
questions.explanation: Calculate using quantitative physical laws in Electronic Devices.
